results.title: Privacy-Preserving Technique - an overview
results.content: Privacy-preserving techniques refer to methods employed to enhance privacy during data processing, allowing computations to be performed on encrypted data while protecting sensitive information. Research in privacy-preserving techniques for Internet of Things (IoT) systems focuses on developing mechanisms such as data anonymization, secure data sharing, and secure multi-party computation to allow legitimate data analysis while preserving the confidentiality and privacy of user information. In fog and edge computing, privacy is maintained by processing data locally and employing techniques such as differential privacy, homomorphic encryption, and secure multi-party computation to ensure data confidentiality during distributed analytics and auto-scaling. Techniques such as secure multi-party computation (SMC), secure data aggregation, or homomorphic encryption enable computations to be performed on encrypted data, preserving privacy. In summary, various privacy-preserving approaches, such as differential privacy, homomorphic encryption, and secure multi-party computation, can be used to preserve data privacy in FL for vehicular communications.
